name: Zannen na Ane to no Love Comedy
source:
Miyuki’s father is a gambler, his mother lives apart from them, and he’s close to being kicked out of school if anything goes wrong. However, he’s pretty happy with his life, being surrounded by his two older sisters and noisy friends.

On New Year’s day, when he and his sisters went to the shrine to make their wishes, their father jumped out from the shrine. He gleefully proclaimed that he was now divorced for good and the Yaegashi family is no more. Miyuki was shocked, but his sisters didn’t seem to mind at all. They both wanted him to live with them and he had until March to decide on who he wanted to go with.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2016/12/05/december-2016-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
美雪的父親是個賭徒，母親與他們分居，只要再出一點問題，他就可能被學校開除。然而，被兩個姊姊和吵鬧的朋友們包圍的他，生活其實相當幸福。

元旦那天，他和姊姊們去神社許願，父親卻從神社裡跳了出來。他得意地宣布自己終於徹底離婚，八重樫家已經不復存在。美雪大受震驚，姊姊們卻似乎毫不在意。她們都想讓美雪和自己一起生活，而他必須在三月前決定跟誰走。

[來源：[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2016/12/05/december-2016-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
